chinese: 农民教我们如何修剪番茄植株的枝叶。
english: the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.

chinese: 这样有助于它们结出更多果实。
english: This helps them to grow more fruit.

chinese: 种植植物需要很多劳作！
虽然很累，但我享受亲手劳动的感觉。
english: It was tiring, but I enjoyed working with my hands.

chinese: 今天我学到的一件事：务农并不容易！
english: One thing I learnt today: Farming isn’t easy!
It made me think of the saying,

chinese: 农民让我们带一些蔬菜回家。
english: The farmer let us take some vegetables home.

chinese: 我妈妈用它们做了晚饭，
english: My mum cooked some for dinner,
and they were fresh and delicious!

chinese: 当你为它们付出劳动后，
它们吃起来确实更美味！
今天真是值得铭记的一天。
english: Today was really a day to remember.
